input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) email links are built from `BASE_URL`, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment. That's why the reset link mkowalczyk and teammates received points at localhost instead of the real app host — `PUBLIC_URL` needs to be set correctly in production, or `BASE_URL` should fail fast / use a proper default when it's missing.

input.title: Fix password reset email using localhost instead of configured URL
input.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. The BASE_URL constant falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, causing password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost in production. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly set/read in the production environment, or that templates.ts fails loudly instead of silently falling back to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a production context.
